about: Stephen A. Melendi attended law school and graduated from Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law in 2003. Stephen Melendi began practicing law in 2003.

Stephen Melendi is an attorney at Tollefson Bradley Mitchell & Melendi, LLP, helping people with Insurance Coverage issues. Tollefson Bradley Mitchell & Melendi, LLP has an office in Dallas, Texas, serving the local community.

Stephen Melendi was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
